# GEMVC

> Server-agnostic PHP REST API framework (Apache / Nginx / OpenSwoole). Four layers: API → Controller → Model → Table/ViewTable. Not Laravel or Symfony.

Version: 5.11.0 (gemvc/library)

## AI must read first

- docs/ai/INDEX.md: Mandatory AI reading order and hard rules
- docs/ai/CANONICAL.md: Architecture, auth, CRUD, Do/Don't
- docs/ai/CORE_REFERENCE.md: Framework class signatures
- AGENTS.md: Universal agent front door (all tools)
- CLAUDE.md: Claude Code entry
- GEMINI.md: Antigravity entry (overrides AGENTS.md on conflict)
- .cursorrules: Cursor short rules (same truth)

## Docs

- docs/README.md: Human + AI documentation index
- docs/guides/ecosystem.md: gemvc/* package map
- docs/guides/api.md: API layer
- docs/guides/controller.md: Controller + createList
- docs/guides/model.md: Model layer
- docs/guides/database.md: Table, ViewTable, migrate
- docs/guides/installation.md: Install → first API
- docs/guides/cli.md: CLI workflows
- docs/guides/security.md: JWT / hardening
- docs/guides/apm.md: APM tracing
- docs/guides/api-documentation.md: Auto @http docs
